title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Path Traversal via glTF External Buffer URIs
description: CVE-2026-129477 is a path traversal vulnerability in Assimp version 4.0 related to handling glTF external buffer URIs. This flaw could allow an attacker to access files outside the intended directory structure. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-22. No CVSS score or exploit in the wild is currently reported.
